explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/675: 'If we partition all primes into P ⊔ Q, such that each set contains ≫ x/log x many primes ≤ x for all large x, then can the set of integers only divisible by primes from P have the translation property?'. The Lean statement reads 'can' existentially: ∃ P ⊆ primes such that both P and its complement in the primes have counting functions ≫ x/log x, and composedOf P (positive integers all of whose prime factors lie in P, including 1) has the translation property. The existential reading is the natural one and is stated in the docstring. Faithful.
